focus: We do this by raising funds for Colombian-led partner organizations that give children ages 5 to 17 access to sports, arts, and education. These consistent, community-rooted programs build confidence and resilience both on and off the field.
origins: Colombia is the most unequal country in Latin America. Rural communities with limited access to quality education and social services are hit hardest. Children pay the price, often pushed into the workforce years before they should be or, in the most vulnerable cases, into armed groups or exploitation.

Powerful Children Colombia was born out of that reality. In May 2021, as COVID-19 deepened economic hardship across the country and youth from working-class neighborhoods were leading nationwide protests against poverty and inequality, four poderosas, Kathy Suarez, Hannah Mora, Johana Suarez and Claudia Daza, held their first meeting to figure out how to help. They landed on a simple idea. The people best positioned to help Colombian children were not outside organizations but the local leaders already doing the work. These leaders knew their communities best and just needed resources to do more.

That idea became Powerful Children Colombia, officially recognized as a 501(c)(3) in January 2022. Today, we raise funds for Colombian-led partner organizations that give children ages 5 to 17 access to sports, arts and education. What started with one founding partner has grown into a network of three, now reaching 335 children across Colombia. We are only getting started.

values.name: Trust
values.body: We prioritize integrity, responsibility, rigor, and transparency when working with donors, Colombian-led orgs and leaders, and our broader community of supporters.

values.name: Inclusion
values.body: We value diversity and ground our work in humility, compassion, and solidarity. Our aim is to intentionally add an inclusion lens to everything we do.

values.name: Joy
values.body: We bring a joyful and child-like spirit to the work we do. This drives our resiliency and keeps us grounded in our commitment to supporting positive opportunities for youth to thrive.

values.name: Collaboration
values.body: We cannot do this work without the partnership of donors, Colombian-led organizations, the global Colombian community, volunteers, and formal and informal advisors. Community-building is core to our work.

values.name: Authenticity
values.body: We are unapologetically ourselves. This includes being courageous and creative in our approach, grounded in our values, and staying connected to our mission of enabling youth to embrace their full power and potential.

programsIndex.title: Programs
programsIndex.intro: Powerful Children Colombia partners with Colombian-led organizations to help design and fund programs for children. Current programs are led in Pereira, Cabrera, and Santa Marta.
programsIndex.criteriaIntro: Powerful Children Colombia identifies Colombian-led partner organizations based on the following criteria:
criteria: The organization's work enables children to embrace their individual power and potential.
The organization's work serves children ages 5 to 17 in under-resourced parts of Colombia through athletic, cultural or educational programs.
The organization is registered as an NGO with the Colombian government.
The organization has a bank account registered under the nonprofit's name.
The organization has documentation of programs and has demonstrated impact.
programsIndex.criteriaOutro: Powerful Children Colombia works closely with partner organizations to design a scope of work for the potential funding opportunity, which includes project objectives, beneficiary description, activities, roadmap, success metrics, and budget. Programs are expected to deliver regular technical and financial reports to update on progress.
programsIndex.criteriaContact: If your organization fits this criteria and you are interested in partnering with us, contact us at info@powerfulchildrencolombia.org.
